cohort: The study included 131,781 infants born to HBsAg-positive pregnant women in Guangdong Province between January 1, 2021, and December 31, 2023.
finding: The overall HBV MTCT rate was 0.44% and the anti-HBs positivity rate was 93.48% among infants completing PVST; maternal age, administration of HepB-BD/HBIG, and antiviral treatment during pregnancy were significantly associated with HBV MTCT, while birth weight, maternal education level, mode of delivery, and number of births were not.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with HBV MTCT risk.
followup_time: At least 7 months, specifically for infants completing post-vaccination serological testing (PVST)
